seo.title: 10-Day Morocco Itinerary | Marrakech, Fes, Sahara & Chefchaouen (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €980 pp. Definitive 10-day Morocco tour circuit (private VIP or group). Marrakech, High Atlas, Erg Chebbi Sahara camp, Fes medina, Chefchaouen & Casablanca.
seo.lead: This ten-day route links Morocco's High Atlas Mountains, the Sahara Desert, all four imperial cities (Marrakech, Fes, Meknes, and Rabat), the blue mountain town of Chefchaouen, and the Atlantic coast in one continuous trip.

price.label: From EUR 980 per person
price.note: Includes private A/C transport for 10 days, licensed driver-guide, 8 nights in boutique riads and hotels, 1 night in an Erg Chebbi desert camp (standard or luxury upgrade available), licensed city guides in Marrakech and Fes, camel rides, dinners in Dades and the desert, and daily breakfasts from Day 2.

seo.imageAlt: Grand Morocco circuit showcasing sweeping Sahara dunes, medieval imperial medinas, Atlas mountain passes, and Chefchaouen
highlights: Guided walking tour of Marrakech, including Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque, and the old souks
Cross the High Atlas Mountains via Tizi n'Tichka pass (2,260m) and visit Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou
Sunset and sunrise camel rides across the Erg Chebbi dunes in Merzouga
Full-day guided walking tour inside the medieval medina of Fes el-Bali
Free time to explore the blue alleys and mountain viewpoints of Chefchaouen
Visit Roman Volubilis, Meknes, Rabat's Hassan Tower, and Casablanca's Hassan II Mosque

faqs.question: Why does the tour start in Marrakech and end in Casablanca?
faqs.answer: Casablanca Mohammed V Airport (CMN) handles the majority of long-haul international flights, making it a convenient exit point without backtracking to Marrakech. However, we can easily run this route in reverse or loop back to Marrakech if your flights require it.

faqs.question: Are local guides included in the imperial cities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Official licensed guides are included for dedicated walking tours in both Marrakech and Fes so you can navigate the souks easily and learn the history behind each landmark.

faqs.question: Is the driving pace exhausting over 10 days?
faqs.answer: No. We intentionally build in two-night stays in Marrakech, Fes, and Chefchaouen so you aren't packing your bags every morning. Vehicles are late-model, air-conditioned, and equipped with Wi-Fi and bottled water.

faqs.question: Can we choose our hotel comfort level?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer three accommodation tiers: Authentic Heritage (traditional riads), Superior Comfort (boutique riads and 4-star hotels), and Luxury VIP (5-star properties and luxury desert tents with private bathrooms).

faqs.question: How much luggage can we bring?
faqs.answer: Because the vehicle is private for your group, there is plenty of trunk space for full-size suitcases and carry-on bags.
